target: doctor.sh forge section — reports the resolved kind and that it came from the environment
cmd:
. "$FIXTURES/forge/setup.sh"; fx_init
fx_gh auth_status 0 "Logged in"
unset FORGE FORGE_URL FORGE_REMOTE FORGE_TOKEN GITLAB_TOKEN
fx_remote https://example.test/o/r.git
export FORGE=github
fx_doctor
grep -q '^forge:' .doctor.out && echo header=yes || echo header=no
fx_sec_has kind_line 'github'
printf '%s\n' "$FX_SEC" | grep -F github | grep -vF .env | grep -Eqi 'env' && echo source_env=yes || echo source_env=no
printf '%s\n' "$FX_SEC" | grep -F github | grep -qF .env && echo source_dotenv=yes || echo source_dotenv=no
fx_done
